positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
1) Lead, designed and built a monitoring dashboard and alerting strategy
2) Created an authentication service utilizing JWT for new types of users to enter the applications
3) Designed and built solutions and patterns on how to replace legacy SOAP API with REST API
4) Cleaned up back-end application code to reduce code size by 25%
5) Continued responsibilities as when associate
6) Mentored other developers

positions.title: Associate Software Developer (Full Stack)
positions.description:
1) Developed back end applications using GraphQL, NodeJS, and MongoDB used by 1000 unique daily user
2) Developed React and Redux clients providing personalized claim filing functionality to Liberty Mutual policy holders
3) Mentored incoming interns

positions.title: Technology Associate
positions.description:
1) Worked in an agile team to centralize the monitoring tools of Liberty Mutual
2) Created dashboards and search's in the following monitoring tools: Splunk, New Relic, Datadog

positions.title: Resident Assistant
positions.description:
Supervised a floor of 32 residents
Organized floor programs
Advised residents on personal and academic issues

positions.title: Integration Intern
